rule_title: CONSTITUTION.md must exist and be the source of truth
message: Repo has no CONSTITUTION.md at root; the brief mandates 'Read CONSTITUTION.md (must exist)'. Critique falls back to the inline kitchensink rules embedded in the brief. The repo should either commit the canonical CONSTITUTION.md or symlink it from the kitchensink root so future critic rounds can cite explicit clauses.
evidence: $ ls CONSTITUTION.md  ->  No such file or directory

rule_title: Deliver ONE coherent thematic improvement per round
message: Commit 6f58ea1 ('kitchensink r0023 test_forge') bundles at least four independent thematic expansions in the same round: a new replay-divergence detector (stepback/divergence.py, +484 LOC), a new corpus-scale counterfactual sweep API (stepback/sweep.py, +527 LOC), a major predicate-DSL expansion (stepback/predicates.py, +564 LOC) and a brand-new Gemini shim path (stepback/shims.py +638 LOC, tests/test_gemini_shim.py +380 LOC). Any one of these is a coherent round on its own; shipping all four together violates Rule 2's 'bundling unrelated fixes is what's forbidden, not bigness'. Future rounds should split these into separate commits.
evidence: git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD: stepback/divergence.py | 484 ++++ ; stepback/sweep.py | 527 ++++ ; stepback/predicates.py | 564 ++++ ; stepback/shims.py | 638 ++++ ; tests/test_gemini_shim.py | 380 ++++ ; tests/test_sweep.py | 325 ++++ ; tests/test_divergence.py | 360 ++++ ; tests/test_predicate_dsl.py | 308 ++++

rule_title: Tests come with features (and TEST-FORGE rounds keep prod read-only)
message: The commit subject is 'kitchensink r0023 test_forge', which per Rule 3b means tests change and 'Default mode: tests change, prod code is read-only.' Instead this commit adds ~2,200 lines of new production code under stepback/ (divergence.py, sweep.py, large predicates.py and shims.py expansions). A test-forge round should not be inventing new public modules; either the commit subject is wrong or the round mixed test-forge with code-forge work.
evidence: git diff --stat HEAD~1 HEAD  ->  stepback/divergence.py +484, stepback/sweep.py +527, stepback/predicates.py +564, stepback/shims.py +638 (all new/expanded production surface)

rule_title: End-to-end fixture testing is mandatory (real fixtures, not mocks)
message: tests/fixtures/ for this repo contains only Python fixture-agent definitions (agent.py, parallel_agent.py); the new test_divergence.py and test_sweep.py drive their pipelines off those synthetic in-process agents rather than a real recorded .sb corpus on disk that would survive a process restart. Consider committing a tiny set of pre-recorded .sb traces under tests/fixtures/traces/ so the divergence + sweep pipelines have an end-goal-realistic corpus matching the v3 testing pattern.

rule_title: Build artefacts (__pycache__/*.pyc) must not be committed
message: Commit 6f58ea1 includes 32 binary __pycache__/*.pyc files under both stepback/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/. These are machine-specific build artefacts (Python 3.11 and 3.14 variants both committed) that bloat diffs, churn on every run, and risk masking real source changes. They should be in .gitignore and removed from the index. While this isn't a literal Rule 5 'sacred files' violation, it touches package internals and pollutes review of dsl.py/runner.py/state.py-adjacent diffs.

rule_title: Agent CLI is the reasoner; OPENAI_API_KEY only for images.generate/edit + Whisper
message: stepback/divergence.py docstring correctly notes 'For the *quality* of an LLM output (is the new answer worse?), use the agent CLI through the existing stepback.report critic surface, not this module.' Spot-checked divergence.py and sweep.py — neither imports openai/anthropic SDKs nor calls REST endpoints; classification is structural (volatile-key strip + JSON shape compare), so this rule is respected. No violation; logged as a positive note for the next round.
evidence: stepback/divergence.py docstring: 'The detector is **not GOFAI**: each rule is a structural fact about JSON shape or a hard-coded volatile-key list; nothing is doing fuzzy text matching or hand-tuned scoring.'
